mapper.select: WITH WFL_ORDERS AS ( SELECT * FROM WFL_STL_PAY_ORDERS T5 WHERE T5.ORDER_ID = (SELECT MAX(T52.ORDER_ID) FROM WFL_STL_PAY_ORDERS T52 WHERE T5.TRADE_ID = T52.TRADE_ID)), deal as ( SELECT * FROM( select deal.*,rank() over(partition by workflow_id order by update_time desc) as rank from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal ) WHERE rank = 1 ), TEMP AS ( SELECT * FROM( select sys_data_process_mark.*,rank() over(partition by workflow_id order by HIS_NO desc) as rank from sys_data_process_mark where page_id in ('DvpOrdersManagement002') ) WHERE rank = 1 ) --DVP指令 select launchUser, finprodId, finprodName, portfolioId, portfolioName, tradeId, totleTradeId, to_number(tradeAmt) tradeAmt, nextUser, createTaskTime, instCode from( select T.create_user as launchUser, '' finprodId, '' finprodName, replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(temp.business_data,'"portfolioId":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"portfolioId":"',''),'"','') portfolioId, replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(temp.business_data,'"portfolioName":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"portfolioName":"',''),'"','') portfolioName, t.trade_id tradeId, '' totleTradeId, replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(temp.business_data,'"settleAmt":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"settleAmt":"',''),'"','') tradeAmt, T.NEXT_USER AS nextUser, T.CRT_DATE AS createTaskTime, sd.institution_code instCode FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T INNER JOIN TEMP on T.seq_no = temp.workflow_id and T.PROCESS_STATE NOT IN ('END','NEW') LEFT JOIN SYS_USER su on T.CRT_USER =su.user_name LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT sd ON SU.DEPT_CODE = sd.Dept_Code where T.crt_date <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) --来帐分拣-片段1 union select T.create_user as launchUser, T4.FINPROD_ID finprodId, nvl(T6.finprod_name,t6.finprod_abbr) finprodName, T4.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T7.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, t.trade_id tradeId, T4.TOTLE_TRADE_ID totleTradeId, nvl(t4.trade_amt,deal.trade_amt) tradeAmt, T.NEXT_USER AS nextUser, T.CRT_DATE AS createTaskTime, sd.institution_code instCode FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T INNER JOIN WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T4 on T.seq_no = t4.workflow_id and T.PROCESS_STATE not in ('END','NEW') LEFT JOIN WFL_PA_TRD_FIN_DEAL_TOTAL T5 ON T4.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T5.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T6 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T7 ON T4.PORTFOLIO_ID = T7.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER su on T.CRT_USER =su.user_name LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT sd ON SU.DEPT_CODE = sd.Dept_Code LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SSAI ON SSAI.SEC_ACCT_ID = T4.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID AND SSAI.TRD_ACCT_CCY = T4.CCY LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON fpt.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPA ON T4.CHL_ID = FPA.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_ORDERS ON T4.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = WFL_ORDERS.TRADE_ID left join deal on deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T4.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where deal.finprod_type!='F16' AND /*过滤产品交易*/ ( (T5.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN ('01', '02', '04', '138','45', '46','47', '48', '49', '50','38', '40', '41', '144') AND (FPA.FINPROD_ID IS NULL OR FPA.PAY_TYPE = '01'))/*非通道或逐笔通道*/ OR (T5.PA_BUSS_TYPE = '34' AND FPA.PAY_TYPE IS NULL) OR (T5.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN ('77') AND FPA.PAY_TYPE = '01' AND SSAI.TRADE_PLACE IN ('01'))/*逐笔划款: 银行间买断式逆回购到期*/ OR (T5.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN ('51') AND FPA.PAY_TYPE = '01' AND SSAI.TRADE_PLACE IN ('01', '03', '04') AND fpt.TYPE_6 = 'H01')/*逐笔划款: 银行间/交易所质押式（协议式）逆回购到期*/ OR (T5.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN ('35', '36', '37') AND (FPA.FINPROD_ID IS NULL OR FPA.PAY_TYPE = '01') AND SSAI.TRADE_PLACE IN ('01'))/*直投/逐笔划款：银行间债券（收息、还本、到期）*/ OR (T5.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN ('35', '36','37') AND FPA.PAY_TYPE = '01' AND SSAI.TRADE_PLACE IN ('03', '04'))/*逐笔划款: 交易所债券（收息、还本、到期）*/ OR (T4.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F29', 'F30', 'F10', 'F11', 'F12', 'F13') AND WFL_ORDERS.PS = '01') ) --AND (WFL_ORDERS.COUNTER_ACCT_NO IS NULL OR WFL_ORDERS.MY_ACCT_NO != WFL_ORDERS.COUNTER_ACCT_NO) --AND T4.PORTFOLIO_ID IS NOT NULL and not exists (select 1 from WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tt where tt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = t4.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID) and T.crt_date <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} --来帐分拣，片段二 union select T.create_user as launchUser, T3.FINPROD_ID finprodId, nvl(T6.finprod_name,t6.finprod_abbr) finprodName, T4.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T7.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, t.trade_id tradeId, t3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID totleTradeId, nvl(total.trade_amt,t3.trade_amt) tradeAmt, T.NEXT_USER AS nextUser, T.CRT_DATE AS createTaskTime, sd.institution_code instCode from deal T3 inner join SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T on t3.workflow_id = T.seq_no and T.PROCESS_STATE not in ('NEW','END') LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T4 ON T3.TRADE_ID = T4.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL total ON total.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T5 ON T3.TRADE_ID = T5.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T6 ON T3.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T7 ON T4.PORTFOLIO_ID = T7.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER su on T.CRT_USER =su.user_name LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT sd ON SU.DEPT_CODE = sd.Dept_Code LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPA ON T3.CHL_ID = FPA.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL PT ON (T3.B_TRADE_ID = PT.P_TRADE_ID or t3.B_TRADE_ID = pt.TRADE_ID) LEFT JOIN WFL_ORDERS ON T3.TRADE_ID = WFL_ORDERS.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON fpt.FINPROD_ID = T3.TRADE_ID where ((T5.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN ('58','54','56','80','66','67','73','68','61','62','64','87','125')) OR (T5.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN ('14','13', '83', '15') AND FPA.PAY_TYPE IS NULL) OR (T5.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN ('10') AND FPA.PAY_TYPE = '01' AND T3.TRADE_MARKET IN ('01','03', '04'))/*逐笔划款: 银行间/交易所债券卖出*/ OR (T5.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN ('74') AND FPA.PAY_TYPE = '01' AND T3.TRADE_MARKET IN ('01'))/*逐笔划款: 银行间买断式正回购首期*/ OR (T5.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN ('11') AND T3.PS = 'T39' AND T3.TRADE_MARKET IN ('01') AND FPA.PAY_TYPE IS NULL)/*直投：银行间债券行权-赎回*/ OR (T5.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN ('11') AND FPA.PAY_TYPE = '01' AND T3.TRADE_MARKET IN ('01','03', '04')) /*逐笔划款的通道交易：银行间/交易所行权-赎回、银行间/交易所行权-回售*/ OR (T5.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN ('20') AND FPA.PAY_TYPE = '01' AND fpt.TYPE_6 = 'H01' AND T3.TRADE_MARKET IN ('01','03', '04')) /*逐笔划款: 银行间/交易所质押式（协议式）正回购首期*/ OR (T3.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F29', 'F30', 'F10', 'F11', 'F12', 'F13') AND WFL_ORDERS.PS = '01')) AND (T5.PA_BUSS_TYPE NOT IN ('58','54','83','56','80','66','67','73','68','125') OR PT.TRADE_ID IS NULL) and T.crt_date <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE}
